summary: Iteration 9 — Tested the 8-item real-world fix batch (cover counts, avoid_staff_pairs, weekend_off_per_rota rules, senior auto-extension, export formatting, /requests enrichment + /inspect, rules seed, UI polish). 11/14 backend pytest PASS, 2 skipped, 1 FAIL. Frontend checks verified Settings Cover Counts UI + Weekend Senior Rotation, Rules shows DEPRECATED legacy + new multi-pair + weekend_off_per_rota, Staff rows tightened to 43-52px, /requests table present. solver/test_runner.py still passes 28/28 [OK]. ONE CRITICAL BACKEND BUG: rules_config migration does NOT seed `avoid_staff_pairs` or `weekend_off_per_rota` into existing DB — these rules appear in rule_definitions.py + UI but are missing from the stored rules_config, so the solver never activates them.

critical.issue: rules_config (live DB) does NOT contain `avoid_staff_pairs` or `weekend_off_per_rota`. db_seeder.py migration loop (line ~214) only lists legacy rule ids. Because the rules_config doc already existed pre-upgrade, the seed-default insert path (line 340) was skipped. Therefore the new rules are never activated even though rule_definitions.py defines them and the UI shows them. Fix: add 'avoid_staff_pairs' and 'weekend_off_per_rota' to the migration tuple on line 214 in /app/backend/db_seeder.py, then restart backend to run migration.

minor.issue: day_cover_count=3 across the full 4-week rota renders the solver INFEASIBLE with the default 8-staff seed. Persistence works. Single-date override on 2026-04-22 via cover_overrides with day_count=3 also risks infeasibility depending on surrounding days. Acceptable trade-off but worth a UI warning.

Returns HTTP 422 (not 200) when infeasible. Body shape is {success:false, reason:..., solver_status:INFEASIBLE} which is actionable, but 422 is misleading since the request was valid; recommend 200 with success:false or 409 Conflict.

rca_of_the_issue: The db_seeder.py `additive rules migration` at line 214 uses a hardcoded tuple of rule ids to backfill onto existing rules_config docs. When the main agent added `avoid_staff_pairs` and `weekend_off_per_rota` to solver/rule_definitions.py, they did not extend that migration tuple. Because the live DB already had a rules_config doc from prior iterations, the seed-default insert path (db_seeder.py:340, which does call default_rules_config() and would have included the new rules) was skipped. Net effect: UI shows the rules (reading from rule_definitions via the UI metadata layer), but GET/PUT /api/rules only round-trips the stored doc, so the solver never sees the new rules activated. Fix: one-line addition of both rule ids to the tuple on line 214, then backend restart.
